meta.description: Shared source of truth for the Palmon Queue Planner. Read by the planner page (client fetch) and, later, the reminder pipeline (GitHub Actions, json.load). Edited by hand: re-anchor FotP per event, overwrite a stage block when a screenshot verifies its rates.

gameClock.note: Fixed UTC-2, no DST. All internal projection math runs on this offset; display in the visitor's local time.

duel.note: Guild Duel: 6 scoring days Mon-Sat, Sunday off. Scoring week starts MONDAY 00:00 server time (= Sunday 19:00 America/Los_Angeles while PDT is in force). The 'Sun 23:00' figure previously recorded here is real but is a different thing: the game's own About panel rule 7 describes a guild-TRANSFER lockout from Sunday 23:00, not the scoring boundary. Use Monday 00:00 for scoring and days; use guildTransferLockout when warning about guild switches. Per-day themes are modelled on the server calendar weekday.

guildTransferLockout.note: Sunday 23:00 server. From the About panel rule 7. NOT the scoring boundary.

duel.personalChestThresholdsNote: Nine tiers, read from the in-game chest ladder. The three values previously here (700000/1000000/2200000) were items 4-6 of this list, not the whole ladder. Identical to Desert Showdown's personal ladder.

scoring.label: Breeding speedup
scoring.note: Camp Nursery. Wednesday is Tech OR Breeding; breeding minutes were previously unscoreable here.

scoring.label: Building, Tech or Training speedup
scoring.note: NOT healing - healing scores on Saturday only.

days.note: Heavy dump day, but NOT universal: Building, Tech and Training score, healing does NOT. The in-game Friday list has no Healing Speedups row. Any hospital strategy that banked on a Friday leg loses it.

scoring.label: Kills / losses (by Armigo level)
scoring.note: 12->48 by Armigo level; awards points for losses too.

days.note: Speedups only (no power points); completions should already have landed.

fotp.note: Front of the Pack: 5 stages of 4h slots, 6 slots/day, each day starting one stage later -> 5-day super-cycle. Re-anchors per event: the opening stage is not stable across events.

anchor.note: Day 1 = Wed Sep 24 00:00 UTC-2. Replaces the August 2026 anchor, which expired 2026-08-21 and had been stale for 37 days. Duration is still unverified; the 14-day span is carried over from the August anchor, so past `expires` reminders still flip to a verify-new-event warning rather than announcing a stale rotation.

train-armigo.label: Train Armigo
train-armigo.chestThresholdsNote: Read from this stage's own chest ladder. The previous 6000/12000/30000 was borrowed from a Guild Duel curve - a different event - and was never observed here.
train-armigo.scoringNote: Per-Armigo points below Lvl 9 are not captured. The previous placeholder cited the Duel Day-5 curve (75->338 for Lv1->10), which belongs to the Guild Duel and does not apply to this stage.

scoring.label: Tech speedup
scoring.note: Magnitude mirrors the Upgrade Buildings shape; awaiting screenshot.

cooldowns.label: Instabuild
cooldowns.note: Counts toward Duel + FotP like speedup minutes, per queue touched (working assumption: up to 8h x 4 queues on a scoring day; verify counter jump on next scoring-day pop). Target phase: Tue -> Thu -> Sat.

cooldowns.label: Instant Build
cooldowns.effect: -600 min on all active build queues
cooldowns.note: Shaves real time for free but destroys burnable minutes. Pop on dead days (Sun/Mon). Do not confuse with Instabuild (camp order).

cooldowns.label: Instant Research
cooldowns.effect: -600 min on all active research queues
cooldowns.note: Same trade-off as Instant Build, for research queues. Pop on dead days.

speedups.generalNote: General speedups count as the type they are spent on for Duel scoring: the flexible reserve, spent last, steered to Friday.
